statement.document_title: The AI Industry Is Lying To You

from_speaker: data centers that won’t be built before
our_interpretation: Assess the construction forecast, rather than the separate complaint about unanswered GPU questions.
The latest day before 2030 is December 31, 2029.
The relevant projects are those underlying the large compute deals discussed by the post, not every data center worldwide.
Treat at this rate as a condition requiring evidence that the relevant construction pace persisted.
Built ordinarily means completion of the relevant facility or contracted phase; an operating portion does not necessarily establish completion of an entire campus.
criteria.support_condition: For an identified project set whose referenced construction pace persisted, the relevant facilities or phases remain incomplete through December 31, 2029.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An identified in-scope facility or contracted phase is completed before January 1, 2030 while the stated construction-rate condition holds.
